content.value_statement: Complex cloud and container networks require coordinated decisions across connectivity, security, performance, and recovery. This skill provides structured architecture and troubleshooting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Designs network architectures for AWS, Azure, GCP, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.
Recommends load balancing, DNS, service discovery, TLS, PKI, VPN, and zero-trust patterns.
Guides troubleshooting across connectivity, DNS, certificates, latency, throughput, packet loss, and application protocols.
Plans container networking and service mesh configurations for Kubernetes environments.
Develops monitoring, redundancy, disaster recovery, capacity, and compliance strategies.
Produces implementation steps, verification checks, rollback considerations, and architecture documentation.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and does not inspect, configure, or validate a live network independently.
Recommendations require accurate topology, traffic, security, compliance, and platform details.
Diagnostic actions require explicit authorization and environment-specific safety controls.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Cloud Network
use_cases.description: Create a secure VPC or virtual network design with routing, segmentation, shared services, and resilient connectivity.

use_cases.title: Resolve Service Connectivity
use_cases.description: Build a layer-by-layer investigation for DNS, TLS, routing, policy, or service mesh failures.

use_cases.title: Review Network Controls
use_cases.description: Assess segmentation, encryption, observability, failover, and compliance requirements before a production change.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Network Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why [symptom] may occur in [environment]. List likely causes, required evidence, and safe verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner investigation of a clearly described network symptom.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Troubleshooting Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a layer-by-layer plan for [issue] in [environment]. Include checks for routing, DNS, TLS, policy, and observability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured diagnosis for an operational incident.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Secure Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design network architecture for [workload] across [platforms]. Address segmentation, identity, encryption, ingress, egress, resilience, monitoring, and cost constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Architecture planning for a new cloud or container workload.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Production Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this migration plan: [plan]. Identify failure modes, security gaps, capacity risks, dependencies, test stages, rollback triggers, and acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a high-impact network change.

output_examples.input: Design private connectivity between two cloud environments for regulated workloads.
output_examples.output: A segmented architecture proposal covering private links, redundant routing, identity controls, encryption, traffic inspection, monitoring, failover tests, and documented trust boundaries.
A prioritized investigation covering service discovery, endpoints, network policies, sidecar health, connection pools, packet loss, latency metrics, and controlled validation steps.

output_examples.input: Review a global load balancing strategy before launch.
output_examples.output: A readiness review addressing health checks, failover behavior, DNS timing, session handling, regional capacity, observability, test cases, and rollback criteria.

best_practices: Provide topology, platforms, traffic flows, constraints, recent changes, and measurable success criteria.
Validate recommendations in a controlled environment before changing production routes, policies, DNS, or certificates.
Use least privilege, documented authorization, staged testing, monitoring, and a verified rollback plan.
anti_patterns: Do not run discovery or scanning tools against systems without explicit authorization and a defined scope.
Do not apply generic configurations without checking platform limits, dependencies, security controls, and failure behavior.
Do not make production network changes without observability, staged validation, communication, and rollback criteria.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, service meshes, hybrid networks, and common enterprise networking technologies.

faq.question: Can it configure my network directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides designs, procedures, checks, and recommendations that authorized operators must validate and execute.

faq.question: Can it help during a network incident?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide symptoms, scope, topology, timestamps, recent changes, and available telemetry for a prioritized troubleshooting plan.

faq.question: Does it support network security reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess segmentation, zero-trust controls, encryption, certificates, firewall policy, observability, resilience, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: What information improves architecture recommendations?
faq.answer: Provide platforms, regions, traffic patterns, availability targets, trust boundaries, compliance needs, budget, growth forecasts, and operational constraints.

faq.question: Does it replace testing or expert review?
faq.answer: No. Every recommendation requires environment-specific validation, authorized testing, change management, and qualified review for critical systems.
